0022600202.text: The Sacramento Kings (1-8, 15th in the West) host the Miami Heat (3-6, 9th in the East) in the Kings' 10th game of the 2026-27 season, with Sacramento on a two-game losing streak and 6.5 games back in the Pacific, while Miami is on a one-game skid. Sacramento is without Ben Simmons (out, Achilles surgery) and Maxime Raynaud (out, dislocated knee), and Domantas Sabonis is day-to-day with knee soreness and is a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27 after splitting their 2025-26 series 1-1, and their most recent meeting was a 130-117 Miami win in Sacramento on January 20, 2026.
